notes: This file is a source inventory only. It does not contain enforceable policy rules.
Gemma must not decide whether a regulatory rule applies. After extraction, the policy engine enforces rules drawn from the operative sources below.
Scope is commercial bank only. Parallel entity tracks are out of this inventory.
Current call conduct for a commercial-bank recovery agent is in the November 28, 2025 Responsible Business Conduct Directions (especially Chapter VIII Section K, including paragraph 445).

The August 12, 2022 recovery-agent circular (paragraph 3) says its requirements supplement and must be read with existing RBI instructions listed in its Annex. This inventory therefore keeps the 2022 circular together with the older bank recovery-agent / outsourcing framework (2006, 2008, and related), rather than treating 2022 as the only source. For commercial banks, later consolidation into the 2025 Responsible Business Conduct Directions is recorded separately under current_applicable.

Customer-service / Fair Practices material is background for recovery practices, grievance handling, confidentiality, and recovery-agent controls. The operative fair-practices and recovery text for commercial banks now sits inside the 2025 Directions.
Bank outsourcing Directions matter because the bank remains responsible for outsourced recovery activity. They govern engagement and oversight, not the words spoken on a call.
Digital-lending guidance applies only when the loan product is digital lending. Do not apply it to every commercial-bank loan.
2006 outsourcing and 2008 recovery-agent circulars are historical/supporting. Do not put them into primary rules.
On January 1, 2027 the Commercial Banks RBC Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026 replace the current recovery sections.
The Hindi RBI site is a language view of the same instruments, not a second legal source. Canonical texts are the English pages on rbi.org.in.

status_values.operative: In force on the inventory date. Store and extract this text for current call behavior.
status_values.issued_not_yet_effective: Final Reserve Bank text whose effective date is still in the future. Store it now. Do not enforce it before effective_from.
status_values.conditional: In force, but only when a product or channel fact is true (for example, digital lending).
status_values.related_cross_reference: A call or grievance flow must account for it, but it is not the recovery-conduct code.
status_values.historical_provenance: Superseded or consolidated. Keep the URL for audit and FAQ lineage. Do not extract it as a current rule.
status_values.historical_supporting: Older background that shaped the current framework. Keep for context. Do not extract as a current rule.
status_values.out_of_scope: Confirmed not to govern this commercial-bank recovery voice agent.

open_gaps: No source PDF or HTML has been saved into this inventory path yet. Next stage is download/ingest into the local corpus.
TRAI TCCCPR, 2018 will bind commercial calling from the January 1, 2027 recovery amendments. It is not an RBI instrument and is not part of this RBI inventory pass.

sources.title: Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026
applies_to: Commercial banks among other covered regulated entities
sources.notes: The agent may tell a borrower how to reach the bank grievance channel and, after that, the Ombudsman. It must not decide that a complaint is maintainable.

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Internal Ombudsman) Directions, 2026
applies_to: Commercial banks with 10 or more banking outlets in India as on March 31, 2025
sources.notes: Bank-side grievance review before rejection. Not a call-script source.

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
applies_to: Digital lending by commercial banks among other covered REs

sections_for_this_agent.topic: Lender must communicate the recovery agent’s particulars by email or SMS before the agent contacts the borrower

sources.notes: Do not automatically apply to every commercial-bank loan. Only when the product is digital lending.

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Credit Facilities) Directions, 2025 — digital-lending chapter only

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Credit Cards and Debit Cards: Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2025
applies_to: Commercial banks, only when the debt being collected is card dues
sources.notes: Card recovery requires disclosure of the agent’s particulars on assignment and limits what customer information the agent may receive. Skip unless the product is a card.

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
applies_to: Commercial banks other than small finance banks, payments banks, regional rural banks, and local area banks
sources.notes: Store now. Do not enforce before January 1, 2027. Replaces the current commercial-bank recovery-agent paragraphs with a common framework: recovery policy, due diligence, IIBF certification, code of conduct, agency disclosure, call recording, contact hours 08:00–19:00, harsh-practice list, dedicated recovery grievance channel.
